# SuperFinder

> SuperFinder is a browser-style file workbench (file manager) for macOS: an address bar where you paste a path and jump straight there, tabs and split panes for comparing, a reference-only staging shelf for gathering files, and full workspace restore when you reopen. Deletes go to the Trash only, and the app itself has zero networking — no account, no cloud, no telemetry.

Quick facts:
- Free download; macOS 14 or later; Simplified Chinese and English UI; current version 1.4.1 (build 8), 2026-10-11
- Two channels: the notarized direct download (Developer ID signed DMG, includes the external plugin port) and the sandboxed App Store build (no plugin port); everything else matches
- Pro (unlocks the external plugin port, ¥38 one-time purchase) is built into the app; the online purchase flow is under construction
- Trust boundaries hard-coded into the product: Trash-only deletes (no permanent-delete entry point, no preference to add one), offline app (plugin networking belongs to the user-installed plugin), every write action is undoable (⌘Z)
- The site you are reading makes zero third-party requests
